screenshots.title: App menu
screenshots.caption: Devices, Projects, Settings, Help and About from the Devices page.

screenshots.title: Measurement destination
screenshots.caption: Choose an existing group or create a new group or project from Save to.

screenshots.title: Devices
screenshots.caption: The discovered Atlas, HBK 2755, Aether, HBK 2255 and Echo.

screenshots.title: Add Device
screenshots.caption: Enter a device IP address when discovery is unavailable.

screenshots.title: Device Authentication
screenshots.caption: Enter the selected device password; the entry is masked.

screenshots.title: Projects
screenshots.caption: Project cards show their groups, measurement counts and available actions.

screenshots.title: New project
screenshots.caption: Set the name and environmental defaults for new measurements.

screenshots.title: Project groups
screenshots.caption: The active destination is marked ACTIVE; Use selects another group.

screenshots.title: Group measurements
screenshots.caption: Separate HBK 2255 and Aether entries identify the receiver for each result.

screenshots.title: Measurement selection
screenshots.caption: Two selected receiver entries, with Move, Export and Delete actions.

screenshots.title: Measurement metadata
screenshots.caption: Edit one receiver result, including its type, distance and speech/noise band levels.

screenshots.title: Capture in progress
screenshots.caption: The recording stage of a source-triggered Echo acquisition.

screenshots.title: Retrieval in progress
screenshots.caption: After capture, allow the receiver data to finish transferring.

screenshots.title: Aether live SLM
screenshots.caption: An ongoing A-weighted, Fast measurement with Stop available.

screenshots.title: Aether completed Leq
screenshots.caption: The final A-weighted equivalent level remains displayed after the ten-second interval.

screenshots.title: Aether recording
screenshots.caption: Recording mode shows the destination, level indication, duration and Record control.

screenshots.title: Live-level configuration
screenshots.caption: L offers both frequency weighting and time weighting.

screenshots.title: Leq configuration
screenshots.caption: Leq offers frequency weighting; its integration time is set on the control page.

screenshots.title: Start calibration
screenshots.caption: Enter the actual calibrator level before selecting Start.

screenshots.title: Calibration in progress
screenshots.caption: The calibration tone has been detected; keep the calibrator in place.

screenshots.title: Calibration complete
screenshots.caption: The result dialog reports the calibration information.

screenshots.title: Aether recovery
screenshots.caption: Password restoration and factory reset are separate actions.

screenshots.title: Restore factory password
screenshots.caption: Enter the original factory password; this example keeps it masked.

screenshots.title: Factory-reset preparation
screenshots.caption: Review the data-loss warning before starting the physical confirmation sequence.

screenshots.title: Final reset confirmation
screenshots.caption: Physical confirmation is complete; Erase and reset is the separate final action.

screenshots.title: Echo control
screenshots.caption: The selected Pink MLS signal, destination, playback and measurement controls.

screenshots.title: Atlas control
screenshots.caption: The gain readout and knob are on the main page, above the playback and measurement controls.

screenshots.title: Echo Pink MLS setup
screenshots.caption: Choose the sequence mode, length and calibrated output level.

screenshots.title: Echo STIPA setup
screenshots.caption: STIPA provides preset output levels, without the custom-level choice shown for Pink MLS.

screenshots.title: Atlas signal setup
screenshots.caption: Choose the signal, mode and length. Set gain on the main Atlas control page.

screenshots.title: Echo User signal setup
screenshots.caption: Select the stored audio and gain, or use Upload and Delete to manage the device copy.

screenshots.title: HBK 2755 control
screenshots.caption: Pink is selected; the gain readout, knob and measurement control are visible.

screenshots.title: HBK 2755 User Signals
screenshots.caption: Select stored audio and use Set as User to assign it to the User control.

screenshots.title: HBK 2255 control
screenshots.caption: The receiver page shows the destination, input-level indication, duration and Record control.

screenshots.title: HBK 2255 eligibility
screenshots.caption: The card reports BZ-7351 missing or inactive; this affects source-triggered measurement eligibility.

screenshots.title: Pressure view
screenshots.caption: A stored Aether receiver result with waveform, selectors and audition control.

screenshots.title: ETC view
screenshots.caption: The energy-time curve of the illustrated impulse response.

screenshots.title: Spectrum view
screenshots.caption: Frequency content of the stored receiver data.

screenshots.title: Spectrogram view
screenshots.caption: Frequency content over the recording duration, with time and frequency axes.

screenshots.title: T20 graph
screenshots.caption: Reverberation time plotted by frequency band.

screenshots.title: T20 table
screenshots.caption: The same parameter in tabular form; an unavailable band is shown as n/a.

screenshots.title: STIPA result
screenshots.caption: An example scalar speech-intelligibility result. Check the measurement type and input data when interpreting it.

screenshots.title: Parameter display
screenshots.caption: Set band resolution, representation, graph appearance and axis limits.

screenshots.title: Export format
screenshots.caption: Choose a desktop DIRAC package or WAV/CSV/TXT data export.

screenshots.title: Data export content
screenshots.caption: Choose audio, calculated results, or both.

screenshots.title: Calculated result format
screenshots.caption: Choose CSV or TXT when exporting calculated results.

screenshots.title: Android save picker
screenshots.caption: Choose the destination and filename, then select Save. Other platforms use their own picker.

screenshots.title: Export complete
screenshots.caption: The app confirms the saved filename after the system save step.

screenshots.title: Aether device settings
screenshots.caption: ID is expanded to show device identity and software version; other sections are collapsed.

screenshots.title: Aether Network settings
screenshots.caption: The station network, Auto-reconnect policy and Device access point editor are shown together.

screenshots.title: Device password
screenshots.caption: Set and confirm a new password, or use Generate and Copy before applying it.

screenshots.title: Receiver measurement settings
screenshots.caption: Save the default distance or start Aether microphone calibration.

screenshots.title: Aether LED settings
screenshots.caption: Adjust ordinary LED brightness and the pre-recording attention time, then Save.

screenshots.title: Aether update available
screenshots.caption: Install software update appears when an update is offered.

screenshots.title: Aether update progress
screenshots.caption: The ID section reports software-download progress.

screenshots.title: Aether rollback offer
screenshots.caption: Review the retained target version before confirming Rollback.

screenshots.title: Measurement filename settings
screenshots.caption: Choose a prefix and optional source/receiver labels; check the example and Save filename format.

screenshots.title: Stored device passwords
screenshots.caption: Clear one stored credential or use Clear All Stored Passwords.

screenshots.title: Forgotten Devices
screenshots.caption: Unblock allows a hidden device to appear in discovery again.

screenshots.title: About DIRAC Field
screenshots.caption: The app identity, version and AE Field branding. The illustrated version is an example, not a latest-version claim.

covered_by_existing.purpose: AE Device access point editor is visible in the combined Network view
